source: TwinLedger master specification §24 tasks 0.3 and 0.8; no organizer deadline, channel or format has been published (docs/QUESTIONS.md OPEN-0).

semantics.deadline: A deadline may only be written here after a human quotes the organizer message (who, where, when). A guessed date is worse than an empty field: it silently destroys the schedule buffer.
semantics.timezone: LOCAL_TIMEZONE is the team's working timezone used for all reporting. Kazakhstan moved to a single UTC+5 zone on 2024-03-01 (Asia/Almaty, Asia/Aqtobe, Asia/Atyrau) and no longer observes DST, so local = UTC+5 year round.
semantics.format: SUBMISSION_FORMAT stays UNKNOWN until the organizers publish it; the repository format is then described in docs/official/SUBMISSION.md.

consistency_rules: If SUBMISSION_DEADLINE_UTC is null then DEADLINE_CONFIRMED_BY must be null.
If SUBMISSION_DEADLINE_UTC is set then DEADLINE_CONFIRMED_BY and DEADLINE_CONFIRMED_AT must both be set.
SUBMISSION_DEADLINE_LOCAL must equal SUBMISSION_DEADLINE_UTC shifted by LOCAL_UTC_OFFSET_HOURS.
